errors.text_span: Visually, the segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size when moving counter-clockwise from the right side of the chart.
errors.evidence: The description claims the segments are arranged in descending order when moving counter-clockwise from the right side. However, starting from the right side (the 'Article editing' slice at 4.1%) and moving counter-clockwise, the segment sizes are 4.1%, 12.8%, and 83.1%. This is an ascending order, not descending.
